Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Girish Kathpalia
 Order
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Petitioners seek quashing of FIR No. 539/2021 of PS Malviya Nagar for offence under Section 420/467/468 IPC on the ground that respondent no.2 has settled the disputes with petitioners.

3. Learned APP assisted by IO/SI Praveen strongly opposes the petition, submitting that there are multiple victims of cheating allegedly committed by the petitioners by way of sequential multiple sales of the property.
4. As requested, status report be filed within four weeks.
It is made clear that there is no stay on proceedings of the trial court.
